name: eis.net
summary: Brisbane ISP (eis.net.au / Elu Information Systems Pty Ltd); BIX participant AS9421; retail ISP phase wound down but entity continues as hosting/network services; ABN and business name EISNET still active.

events.details: Death researched Aug 2026: Elu Information Systems Pty Ltd ABN 15 080 110 809 still Active; business name EISNET still current; eis.net.au live (MediaWiki); AS9421 allocated but not visible in global routing. Retail ISP phase wound down but entity continues as hosting.
